original.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to India-Japan economic ties as reported in July 2026:
items: India-Japan bilateral trade in 2025-26 — USD 27.5 billion
Japan's pledged investment in India by the mid-2030s — over USD 61 billion
Stake acquired by Japan in Yes Bank — 20%
original.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
original.explain: All three are correct: trade reached USD 27.5 billion in the last financial year, Japan pledged to more than double investment to over USD 61 billion, and it took a 20% stake in Yes Bank for USD 1.6 billion. Japan also backs the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor.
original.source: Bilateral trade reached USD 27.5 billion in the last financial year, and Modi's Tokyo visit last year secured a Japanese pledge to more than double investment in India to over USD 61 billion by the mid-2030s.
